description: Live SEC filing events market-wide (8-K, form 4, S-1/F-1/424B4 IPO filings) since a cursor. params: since, forms, items, ticker, cik, limit [$0.02/call]. Params — since: ISO 8601 UTC, unix seconds, or the cursor (c:...) from a previous answer; only events after it, oldest first, paged: follow `cursor` while `more` is true; forms: comma list from 8-K,4,S-1,F-1,424B4 (amendments ride with their base form); items: comma list of 8-K item codes, e.g. 2.02,5.02; ticker: one company by ticker; cik: one company by SEC CIK; limit: 1-200 Example params: {'forms': '8-K', 'items': '2.02,5.02', 'limit': 5}
name: sec_events
